title.narrative: Time for building permits to be issued from submission of completed documents, in AMC

comment.narrative: This indicator is proposed to be dropped during restructuring as the timelines for implementation of the online building plan approval module under mSeva have been delayed. Since the module has not yet been rolled out yet, the indicator cannot be reliably measured within the current project period. Moreover, the focus of performance monitoring has shifted from processing speed to ensuring system reliability, user adoption, and integration with other urban e-governance modules. Hence, the indicator is being removed to avoid duplication and to allow monitoring efforts to concentrate on more relevant outcomes.

title.narrative: Improved MC operational efficiency in Amritsar as measured by enhancement in e-governance

comment.narrative: The deployment of core governance and urban finance systems across Amritsar and Ludhiana has achieved notable milestones. The Asset Management System (SAP) went live in both Municipal Corporations on May 1, 2025, and the mSeva citizen services platform has expanded significantly, with eight of nine modules either live or near completion. The OneMap GIS platform is operational and supporting planning functions in both cities.

title.narrative: Social accountability strengthened in AMC as measured by social audits introduced

comment.narrative: A pilot survey conducted in September 2024 generated Citizen Scorecards for Ludhiana and Amritsar, based on 6,000 and 5,000 responses respectively. Ludhiana scored 58 and Amritsar 55 out of 100. Following the pilot, an online application has been developed to support future surveys. Questionnaire preparation is underway, and the next round of Citizen Scorecards will be based on the upcoming survey results.
